title: SARS-CoV-2 infection-induced human B cells
description: This study was designed to capture the single cell transcriptome and BCR sequence of B cells that were bait sorted using oligo-tagged viral antigens. Overall design: Human B cells (viable/CD19+/antigen-PE+ or viable/CD19+/antigen-APC+) were bait sorted after initial magnetic enrichment and used in downstream sequencing.
